name: RFQ-Core
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y default-mysql-client libzip-dev && sudo docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql zip bcmath 2>/dev/null || true; composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist || true; cp -n .env.example .env 2>/dev/null || true; php artisan key:generate --force 2>/dev/null || true; touch database/database.sqlite 2>/dev/null || true; php artisan migrate --force 2>/dev/null || true; php artisan db:seed --force 2>/dev/null || true; php artisan storage:link 2>/dev/null || true
